known_parity_gaps: dump_session, dump_session_file, to_canonical_json, canonical_bytes, to_canonical_dict, normalize, content identity, compute_content_hash, and reparse_identity_hashes: Rust returns a typed unavailable error because model cannot depend on codec or adapters; Python performs the real call — parity not required here.
get_session_schema_path and load_session_schema: Rust does not read schemas/ — parity not required here.
The text after the colon in a JSON syntax error and in a UTF-8 decode error: parity on detail tail is not required.
FileNotFoundError versus SchemaError for a missing file: parity on exception type is not required; a missing-file vector may compare message text only.
Unicode Nd timestamp digits, a non-str timestamp, an int outside i64, a non-string object key, frozenset iteration order, and a set used as a payload container: parity not required here.
